argument: Impedance is not read here as a bare ratio: the statement builds its magnitude out of resistance and the two reactances, three resistance-carrying oppositions (an odd number) combining into the total limit an alternating flow meets. A limit caused by resistance turns around, so the definition's opposition content flips into receptivity even though the formula is untouched.
reflected_sentence: Read receptively, the whole receptivity met by an alternating flow combines alignment with receptivity to change; as the gap narrows, the flow that moves rises.
